item.title: Kim Yong, Excluded from Party Nomination: "I Respect the Committee's Decision… Will Serve as a Foot Soldier" (공천 배제된 김용 “공관위 판단 존중… 백의종군하겠다”)
item.description:
Kim Yong, Excluded from Party Nomination: "I Respect the Committee's Decision… Will Serve as a Foot Soldier" (공천 배제된 김용 “공관위 판단 존중… 백의종군하겠다”)

Kim Yong, former deputy director of the Democratic Party Research Institute, who was excluded from the nomination for the June 3 by-elections for the National Assembly, said on the 28th, "I accept the decision with a heavy heart," adding, "I will serve as a foot soldier." (더불어민주당의 6·3 국회의원 재·보궐선거 공천에서 배제된 김용 전 민주연구원 부원장이 28일 “결정을 무겁게 받아들인다”며 “백의종군하겠다”고 했다.)

Kim, a close aide to President Lee Jae-myung, was convicted in a second trial on charges of receiving illegal political funds from a private developer in the Daejang-dong scandal. He was released on bail last year and is awaiting a Supreme Court ruling. Kim had expressed his intention to run in the June 3 by-election in a Gyeonggi Province constituency, but the Democratic Party decided to exclude him from the nomination on the 27th. Democratic Party Secretary General Cho Seung-rae stated, "We judged that it is appropriate not to nominate him after comprehensively considering the impact on the election." <<> Kim held a press conference at the National Assembly on the afternoon of the 28th and said, "I accept the decision made by the Strategic Nomination Management Committee with a heavy heart. I respect the committee's deliberations and strategic judgment, and I will serve as a foot soldier." He added, "If my sacrifice becomes a foundation for the success of the Lee Jae-myung government and the Democratic Party's victory, I will step down joyfully." <<> However, Kim also stated, "But let me make this clear: the indictment against me is a clear manipulation by political prosecutors and a shabby act of political retaliation." He said, "If I collapse here, it will set a precedent where fabricated investigations triumph. I will never stop and will prove my innocence to the end. I will thoroughly dismantle the prosecutors' fabricated charges, and on the ground, I will dedicate myself in the lowest place for the success of the Lee Jae-myung government." <<> Regarding the specific form of his "service as a foot soldier" and his future plans, Kim said, "I haven't thought much about the details of what I need to do," adding, "I will find work to do from the ground up." He also said, "As a politician, I intend to continue my political career," and expressed hope that "the judiciary will deliver a ruling promptly." (이재명 대통령의 최측근인 김 전 부원장은 대장동 민간업자에게 불법 정치자금을 받은 혐의 등으로 2심에서 유죄를 선고받고 지난해 보석으로 풀려나 대법원 판결을 앞두고 있다. 김 전 부원장은 6·3 재보선에서 경기도 지역에 출마하겠다는 의사를 밝혀 왔으나, 민주당은 지난 27일 공천 배제를 결정했다. 민주당 조승래 사무총장은 “선거에 미치는 영향을 종합적으로 판단해서 공천하지 않는 것이 적절하다고 판단했다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Just as Admiral Yi Sun-sin Saved the Nation, We Will Exert All Efforts to Overcome the National Crisis" (李대통령 “이순신 장군이 나라 구했듯, 국난 극복에 전력”)
item.description:
President Lee: "Just as Admiral Yi Sun-sin Saved the Nation, We Will Exert All Efforts to Overcome the National Crisis" (李대통령 “이순신 장군이 나라 구했듯, 국난 극복에 전력”)

President Lee Jae-myung attended the commemoration ceremony for the 481st anniversary of the birth of Admiral Yi Sun-sin held in Asan, South Chungcheong Province on the 28th, stating, "Just as Admiral Yi Sun-sin saved the nation from a national crisis, it is our calling to overcome the current crisis together." This marks the first time a sitting president has attended the birthday commemoration for Admiral Yi since the late former President Kim Young-sam. (이재명 대통령은 28일 충남 아산에서 열린 충무공 탄신 제481주년 기념행사에 참석해 “이순신 장군께서 국난으로부터 나라를 구했듯 지금의 위기를 함께 극복하는 것이 우리에게 주어진 소명”이라고 말했다. 현직 대통령이 충무공 탄신 기념행사에 참석한 것은 고(故) 김영삼 전 대통령 이후 처음이다.)

In his congratulatory speech at the event, President Lee referenced the crisis faced by Admiral Yi Sun-sin during the Imjin War (Japanese invasions of Korea, 1592-1598), saying, "The reality we face today is as formidable and fierce as the waves of that era." He added, "The rapidly changing international order is creating uncertainty where it’s hard to predict even what lies just ahead, and the rise in energy prices and price instability due to the Middle East war are significantly impacting our economy and the lives of our people." He emphasized, "To withstand the fierce gales blowing from outside, strong internal cohesion that remains unshaken is essential." (이 대통령은 이날 행사 축사에서 이순신 장군이 임진왜란 당시 처했던 위기를 언급하며 “오늘날 우리가 마주하고 있는 현실 또한 그 시절의 파고만큼이나 높고 거세다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 “급변하는 국제 질서는 한 치 앞도 예측하기 힘든 불확실성을 낳고, 중동 전쟁으로 인한 에너지 가격 상승과 물가 불안은 우리 경제와 국민의 삶에도 크게 영향을 미치고 있다”며 “외부에서 불어오는 거센 풍랑을 이겨내려면 내부에서 흔들리지 않는 강한 결속력은 필수”라고 했다.)

President Lee noted, "The reason Admiral Yi Sun-sin was able to defeat a Japanese fleet more than ten times larger with just 13 ships was possible because everyone, from the admiral to the soldiers and the people, united with one heart and mind." He declared, "The people-centered government will take the spirit of Admiral Yi Sun-sin as a guiding light and use the strong force of national unity as a driving force to do everything in its power to overcome the national crisis." (이 대통령은 “이순신 장군께서 불과 13척의 배로 열 배가 훨씬 넘는 왜군 함대를 격파할 수 있었던 것도 장군부터 병사와 백성들에 이르기까지 모두가 한마음으로 똘똘 뭉쳤기에 가능한 일이었다”며 “국민주권 정부는 이순신 장군의 정신을 등불 삼고 국민통합의 강한 힘을 원동력 삼아 국난 극복을 위해 전력을 다하겠다”고 했다.)

President Lee said, "The secret to Admiral Yi Sun-sin's ability to write a legend of consecutive victories on the battlefield, where he risked life and death, lay elsewhere." He explained, "It was because he was armed with a solemn sense of mission and a spirit of love for the people, determined that 'to live, you must be ready to die, and to die, you must be ready to live,' fully prepared to give his life to protect only this country and its people." President Lee concluded, "Together with the great Korean people, we will overcome the current crisis and move unwaveringly toward a more prosperous and fair Republic of Korea, a nation where all citizens are happy." (이 대통령은 “이순신 장군께서 사선을 넘나드는 전장 속에서 연전연승의 신화를 써 내려갈 수 있었던 비결은 다른 데 있지 않았다”며 “생즉사 사즉생(生卽死 死卽生), 죽음을 각오하고 오직 이 나라와 백성의 안전을 지켜내야 한다는 준엄한 소명의식과 애민정신으로 무장해 있었기 때문”이라고 했다. 이 대통령은 “위대한 대한국민과 함께 지금의 위기를 이겨내고, 더 부강하고 공정한 대한민국, 국민 모두가 행복한 나라를 향해 흔들림 없이 나아가겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Chu Kyung-ho, People Power Party’s Daegu Mayor Candidate, Appoints Kim Moon-soo as Honorary Election Committee Chair (추경호 국민의힘 대구시장 후보, 명예선대위원장에 김문수 위촉)
item.description:
Chu Kyung-ho, People Power Party’s Daegu Mayor Candidate, Appoints Kim Moon-soo as Honorary Election Committee Chair (추경호 국민의힘 대구시장 후보, 명예선대위원장에 김문수 위촉)

The camp of Chu Kyung-ho, a People Power Party lawmaker and candidate for Daegu mayor, announced on the 28th that they have appointed former Employment and Labor Minister Kim Moon-soo, who was also the party’s presidential candidate, as the honorary election committee chair. (국민의힘 대구시장 후보인 추경호 국회의원 측은 같은 당 대통령 선거 후보였던 김문수 전 고용노동부 장관을 명예선대위원장으로 위촉했다고 28일 밝혔다.)

Chu’s camp explained that under the plan to swiftly form an election campaign structure ready for immediate on-the-ground deployment, they have appointed Kim, the party’s most recent and largest-scale election contender, as the honorary election committee chair. Chu’s camp further noted that Kim, a native of Yeongcheon, North Gyeongsang Province, and a graduate of Daegu’s Gyeongbuk High School, is the right person to lead victory in the Daegu and North Gyeongsang elections. (추 의원 측은 당장 현장 투입이 가능한 선거 캠프 체제를 조속히 구성해야 한다는 구상 아래 국민의힘에서 가장 최근에, 가장 큰 선거를 치른 김 전 대선 후보를 명예선대위원장으로 위촉하게 됐다고 설명했다. 경북 영천 출신으로, 대구 경북고를 졸업한 김 명예선대위원장은 대구·경북 선거 승리를 이끌 적임자라고 추 의원 측은 설명했다.)

Chu stated, “In the last presidential election, former candidate Kim Moon-soo and the People Power Party appealed to prevent the Democratic Party’s legislative dictatorship followed by its seizure of the executive branch from shaking the nation’s very foundations, and the citizens of Daegu responded with overwhelming support of 67.62%.” He added, “I believe that in this Daegu mayoral election, you will choose Chu Kyung-ho as a counterbalance to check the running amok of the Lee Jae-myung administration, as the last bastion and breakwater of the Republic of Korea’s liberal democracy.” (추 의원은 “지난 대선에서도 김문수 대선 후보와 국민의힘은 민주당의 입법 독재에 이은 행정부 장악으로 나라의 근간과 뿌리가 흔들리는 것만은 막아달라고 호소했고 이에 대구 시민께서 67.62%라는 압도적인 성원을 보내주셨다”며 “이번 대구시장 선거에서도 이재명 정권의 폭주를 견제할 균형추, 대한민국 자유민주주의의 마지막 보루이자 방파제로서 추경호를 선택해 주실 것이라 믿는다”고 말했다.)

Chu plans to resign from his parliamentary seat on the 29th, register as a preliminary candidate on the 30th, and hold the opening ceremony for his election campaign office at the Beomeo Intersection in Suseong-gu, Daegu, on the 3rd of next month. (추 의원은 29일 국회의원직을 사퇴하고 30일 예비 후보 등록을 한 뒤 다음 달 3일 대구 수성구 범어네거리에 마련한 선거사무소 개소식을 할 예정이다.)

item.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs “Reviewing Sending Reply to US Republican Lawmakers’ ‘Coupang Letter’” (외교부 “美 공화 의원들 ‘쿠팡 서한’에 답신 발송 검토 중”)
item.description:
Ministry of Foreign Affairs “Reviewing Sending Reply to US Republican Lawmakers’ ‘Coupang Letter’” (외교부 “美 공화 의원들 ‘쿠팡 서한’에 답신 발송 검토 중”)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated on the 28th that it is considering sending a reply to the open letter from US Republican House members requesting an end to “discriminatory regulations against US companies” in connection with the Coupang issue. <<> Ministry spokesperson Park Il said at a regular briefing that day, “We are consulting with relevant agencies on sending a reply.” He also noted, “The investigation and measures regarding Coupang are being carried out in accordance with domestic laws and due process, and are applied non-discriminatorily regardless of nationality,” adding that the government has consistently explained this stance to the US administration and Congress. <<> If the reply is sent, it is expected to include a detailed explanation of the legal procedures under domestic law, as well as the scale and severity of the damage caused by Coupang’s personal data leak. <<> Earlier, on the 21st (local time), 54 US Republican House members sent an open letter to Korean Ambassador to the US Kang Kyung-wha, referencing the Coupang issue and requesting that “the Korean government immediately cease its targeted attacks against US companies.” <<> In this regard, a foreign ministry official noted that even before this letter was received, some US congressional offices had sent similar letters, and the ministry had either replied or visited the offices to provide explanations. The official added, “This is an example of how seriously the current US Congress views issues of discriminatory treatment of their companies abroad.” (외교부는 미국 공화당 하원 의원들이 쿠팡 문제와 관련해 ‘미국 기업에 대한 차별적 규제를 중단해달라’고 보낸 공개서한에 대해 답신 발송을 검토 중이라고 28일 밝혔다.)

item.title: Kim Seong-tae on 'Illegal Remittance to North Korea' Praises Prosecutor Park Sang-yong: "He Really Worked Hard on the Investigation" (‘대북 송금’ 김성태, 박상용 검사에 “수사 정말 열심히 해” 칭찬)
item.description:
Kim Seong-tae on 'Illegal Remittance to North Korea' Praises Prosecutor Park Sang-yong: "He Really Worked Hard on the Investigation" (‘대북 송금’ 김성태, 박상용 검사에 “수사 정말 열심히 해” 칭찬)

<<>> Former Ssangbangwool Chairman Kim Seong-tae stated on the 28th regarding Prosecutor Park Sang-yong, who investigated the illegal remittance case to North Korea, "I don't usually praise prosecutors, but based on what I felt, he really worked hard on the investigation." ()

Former Chairman Kim appeared as a witness at a comprehensive hearing of the National Assembly's Special Committee on the 'Suspicion of Manufacturing Prosecution by the Yoon Suk-yeol Administration' led by the Democratic Party of Korea, which focused on the Ssangbangwool illegal remittance case. In response to a question from Democratic Party lawmaker Jeon Yong-gi, who asked whether he felt pressured by Prosecutor Park, Kim gave this answer. The Democratic Party believes that Prosecutor Park, as the prosecutor in charge of the Ssangbangwool remittance case at the time, provided various conveniences to Kim and others to coax their statements. (김성태 전 쌍방울 회장이 28일 쌍방울 불법 대북 송금 사건을 수사한 박상용 검사에 대해 “제가 검사들 칭찬할 일도 없는데 제가 느낀 바로 말씀드리면 수사 정말 열심히 했다”고 했다.)

Former Chairman Kim said, "The Prosecutor Park Sang-yong I saw had lost about 15 kg of weight," adding, "Seeing him this time made me feel sorry too." He continued, "I'm not taking Prosecutor Park's side. I never take a prosecutor's side," and "I was someone whose limbs trembled before prosecutors too. I even wrote suicide notes several times. But they also have their own positions, don't they?" (김 전 회장은 이날 오후 더불어민주당이 주도하는 국회 ‘윤석열 정권 조작 기소 의혹 사건 국정조사’ 특별위원회의 쌍방울 대북 송금 사건 관련 종합 청문회에 증인으로 출석해 “박상용 검사가 압박했다는 느낌을 받았냐”는 취지의 전용기 더불어민주당 의원의 질의에 이같이 말했다. 민주당은 박 검사가 당시 쌍방울 대북 송금 담당 검사로 김 전 회장 등에게 각종 편의를 봐주며 진술 회유를 했다고 보고 있다.)

He also refuted claims by Democratic Party lawmakers that Prosecutor Park coaxed him by offering his office for prison management and helping him run the company from jail. (김 전 회장은 “제가 본 박상용 검사님은 살이 한 15kg 빠졌다”며 “이번에 보면서 안타깝기도 했다”고 했다. 이어 “박상용 검사 편을 드는 건 아니다. 검사 편 절대 안 든다”며 “저도 검사에게 사지가 떨렸던 사람이다. 유서도 몇 번 썼다. 그런데 그들도 자기네 입장이 있지 않겠느냐”고 했다.)

Former Chairman Kim said, "Lawmakers say I received care and managed the company from inside, but why would I manage a company in a prosecutor's office?" adding, "If I were to manage the company, I could just give instructions through my lawyer when they visit the detention center." (그는 박상용 검사가 김 전 회장에게 검사실을 내어주며 옥중 경영을 할 수 있도록 도와주며 회유했다는 민주당 의원들의 주장에 대해서도 반박했다.)

He also denied the so-called 'salmon drinking party coaxing allegation,' saying, "That never happened." President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party have claimed that "the prosecution coaxed former Chairman Kim and former Vice Governor Lee Hwa-young with alcohol and salmon to manipulate their statements." (김 전 회장은 “의원님들은 제가 무슨 수발을 받고 (안에서) 회사를 경영했네 그러시는데 회사 경영을 검사실에서 왜 합니까?”라며 “회사 경영할 거 같으면 구치소 변호사들 오면 변호인 통해서 지시하면 되는 것”이라고 했다.)

In response to People Power Party lawmaker Shin Dong-wook's question, "What did you think when you read the article about a salmon sashimi party on May 17?", former Chairman Kim replied, "Honestly, I laughed." He said, "These days, detention centers aren't like they used to be. You can't even imagine things like cigarettes or alcohol." (그는 이른바 ‘연어 술 파티 회유 의혹’에 대해서도 “그런 사실이 없었다”고 부인했다. 이재명 대통령과 더불어민주당 측에서는 “검찰이 김 전 회장과 이화영 전 부지사에게 술과 연어를 주며 회유해 진술을 조작했다”고 주장해왔다.)

Former Ssangbangwool Director Park Sang-woong, who was known to have purchased soju with a Ssangbangwool corporate card at a convenience store in front of the Suwon District Prosecutors' Office at the time, also attended and said in response to a question about why he bought the alcohol, "I bought it for personal consumption. At that time, I was in so much pain that I couldn't get through the days without alcohol." The ruling party claims that on May 17, an employee purchased soju with a Ssangbangwool corporate card at a convenience store in front of the Suwon District Prosecutors' Office and brought it into the prosecution building. (김 전 회장은 “5월 17일에 연어회 파티가 있었다는 기사를 보면서 어떤 생각을 했느냐”는 신동욱 국민의힘 의원 질의에 “솔직히 웃었다”고 답했다. 그는 “요새 구치소라는 데가 옛날 같지가 않아서 담배라든지 술 이런 것 상상을 못한다”고 했다.)

Former Director Park said, "I have been subjected to intense investigations multiple times at the Suwon District Prosecutors' Office, the Gyeonggi Nambu Provincial Police Agency, and the High Court's Human Rights Violation Task Force, and I have consistently maintained my statements." He added, "Vice Governor Lee Hwa-young initially said the salmon and soju party was in July, then changed it countless times to late June, mid-June, and early July. From my perspective, if I hadn't bought that alcohol for myself with the corporate card that day, I don't know what judgment or outcome would have come of this case. I believe this happened because of my immoral act, and it truly breaks my heart." (당시 쌍방울 법인 카드로 수원지검 앞 편의점에서 소주를 산 것으로 알려진 박상웅 전 쌍방울 이사도 이날 출석해 “당시 술을 왜 샀느냐”는 질의에 “개인적으로 먹으려고 산 것이다. 그때 당시에 너무나도 고통스럽고 술이 아니면 세월을 살 수가 없었다”고 했다. 여권에선 5월 17일 당시 수원지검 앞 편의점에서 쌍방울 법인 카드로 소주가 결제된 점을 들어 해당 직원이 술을 사서 검찰청사 안으로 반입했다고 주장하고 있다.)

item.title: "Lee Sent Him Off with a Smile and Grace"... Ha Jung-woo's Resignation Approved (“李, 웃으며 쿨하게 보내줬다”...하정우 사표 재가)
item.description:
"Lee Sent Him Off with a Smile and Grace"... Ha Jung-woo's Resignation Approved (“李, 웃으며 쿨하게 보내줬다”...하정우 사표 재가)

President Lee Jae-myung on the 28th approved the resignations submitted by Ha Jung-woo, Senior Presidential Secretary for AI Future Strategy, and Spokesperson Jeon Eun-su. Secretary Ha and Spokesperson Jeon are set to run in the parliamentary by-elections held alongside the June 3 local elections, in Busan's Buk-gu District and Chungnam's Asan-eul District, respectively. (이재명 대통령은 28일 하정우 AI미래기획수석과 전은수 대변인이 제출한 사표를 재가했다. 하 수석과 전 대변인은 6월 3일 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 국회의원 보궐선거에서 각각 부산 북갑, 충남 아산을 지역에 출마한다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung said, "President Lee readily accepted Secretary Ha's resignation letter, stating he 'respects the difficult decision.' He added, 'I hope you fulfill your role for the nation and its people wherever you go and whatever you do.'" (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 “이 대통령은 하 수석의 사직서 제출에 ‘어려운 결정 존중한다’며 흔쾌히 수락했다”며 “덧붙여 ‘어디에서 어떤 일을 하든지 국가와 국민을 위해 역할을 하기 바란다’고 했다”고 전했다.)

Secretary Ha is running in the by-election for Busan's Buk-gu District, triggered after Democratic Party lawmaker Jeon Jae-soo was chosen as the party's candidate for Busan mayor. Ha's resignation comes just 10 months after he was appointed to the newly established post of Senior Presidential Secretary for AI Future Strategy when the government launched last June. (하 수석은 전재수 더불어민주당 의원이 당의 부산시장 후보로 결정되면서 치러지게 된 부산 북갑 지역 보궐선거에 나선다. 하 수석의 사직은 작년 6월 정부 출범 뒤 신설된 AI미래기획수석에 발탁된 지 10개월 만이다.)

Meeting with reporters at the Cheong Wa Dae Chuncheon Hall on Tuesday, Secretary Ha said of his resignation and decision to run, "I will dedicate myself to building a country where our children have a future and opportunities for growth." (하 수석은 이날 청와대 춘추관에서 기자들과 만나 사직과 출마 결정에 대해 “우리 아이들에게 미래가 있는, 성장의 기회가 있는 나라를 만드는 데 헌신하겠다”고 말했다.)

Ha added, "When I earned my Ph.D. and went to Naver, and when I worked at Naver for 10 years before coming to Cheong Wa Dae, the standard for my choices was always what I needed to do at that moment to make South Korea one of the top three AI powers. I have never wavered from this direction, and now it seems I will be taking on a different task." Ha earned his bachelor's, master's, and doctoral degrees in computer science from Seoul National University, and later served as head of the AI Innovation Center and director of the AI Lab at Naver. <<> When rumors emerged that the ruling party was considering recruiting Ha, President Lee reportedly told him at a meeting on the 9th, "You have a lot of work to do; you can't just leave if a job offer comes in." This led to speculation that President Lee might oppose Ha's candidacy. <<> However, Secretary Ha said on Tuesday, "The President readily agreed and saw me off with a smile. He smiled and said, 'You've made a big decision. Wherever you go, work for the national interest and the people,' and sent me off gracefully." <<> Spokesperson Jeon Eun-su also told reporters on Tuesday morning, "I've been by the President's side, but now I will communicate on the front lines and ensure the people get accurate information without distortion. I will engage in politics for the people." <<> Jeon, who previously worked as a lawyer in the Ulsan region, ran in the 2024 general election for Ulsan's Nam-gu District but lost. After the current administration took office, he was appointed deputy spokesperson and promoted to spokesperson earlier this month. The Chungnam Asan-eul District, where Jeon is running, has been vacant since former district lawmaker Kang Hoon-sik became Presidential Chief of Staff last June. <<> President Lee also approved the resignation of Kim Sung-beom, Vice Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. Within political circles and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, there are expectations that Vice Minister Kim will run in the Seogwipo City by-election, triggered after Democratic Party lawmaker Wi Seong-gon was selected as the party's candidate for Jeju governor. (하 수석은 “박사 학위를 받고 네이버에 갔을 때, 네이버에서 10년을 일하고 청와대에 왔을 때도 그 시점에서 우리나라를 AI 3대 강국으로 만들 수 있는, (그걸 위해) 내가 지금 해야 할 일이 무엇인지가 (선택의) 기준이었다”며 “한 번도 이 방향성을 바꿔본 적이 없고, 지금은 또 다른 일을 하게 될 것 같다”고 했다. 하 수석은 서울대에서 컴퓨터공학 전공으로 학·석·박사 학위를 받았고, 이후 네이버에서 AI이노베이션센터장, AI랩 소장 등을 맡았다.)

item.title: Gyeongnam Governor Candidates from Both Major Parties Sway Voters with "Tangible Welfare" Pledges (경남도지사 양당 후보, ‘체감형 복지’ 공약으로 표심 흔든다)
item.description:
Gyeongnam Governor Candidates from Both Major Parties Sway Voters with "Tangible Welfare" Pledges (경남도지사 양당 후보, ‘체감형 복지’ 공약으로 표심 흔든다)

Ahead of the June 3 local elections, People Power Party candidate Park Wan-soo, who is seeking re-election as Gyeongnam Province Governor, has put forward a "welfare" card as his first pledge. This strategy aims to win voters by alleviating the financial burdens on residents, which have been exacerbated by high prices and a slowing economy. Meanwhile, Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyoung-soo is fighting back by sequentially announcing life-oriented pledges that address the everyday inconveniences of residents. (6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 경남도지사 재선에 도전하는 국민의힘 박완수 후보가 1호 공약으로 ‘복지’ 카드를 꺼내 들었다. 고물가와 경기 둔화로 가중된 도민들의 살림살이 부담을 덜어주는 전략으로 표심을 잡겠다는 전략이다. 더불어민주당 김경수 후보도 도민의 일상적 불편을 해소하는 생활 밀착형 공약을 순차적으로 발표하면서 맞불을 놨다.)

On the 28th, candidate Park Wan-soo held a press conference at the Gyeongnam Provincial Government Press Center to announce his first pledge, the "Happiness UP 5 Major Welfare Plans," after registering as a preliminary candidate. A key feature is its focus on "gap groups," such as those in their 40s and 50s and women, who have been relatively neglected within the national welfare system. This is seen as a tailored policy targeting groups with weaker support bases. (박완수 후보는 28일 경남도청 프레스센터에서 기자회견을 열고 예비 후보 등록 후 첫 공약으로 ‘행복 UP 5대 복지’를 발표했다. 그간 국가 복지 체계에서 상대적으로 소외됐던 40~50대와 여성 등 ‘틈새 계층’을 집중 공략한 것이 특징이다. 상대적으로 지지 기반이 약한 계층을 겨냥한 맞춤형 정책이라는 분석이다.)

The core initiative is the "Gyeongnam Province Resident Membership Card," which would be issued to all residents aged 18 and over. The plan is to consolidate discounts for shopping, culture, and transportation, as well as for using public parking lots and facilities, onto this single card. He also promised that through a dedicated app, residents could earn mileage points for walking or volunteering, which could be used like cash. (핵심은 18세 이상 도민에게 발급하는 ‘경남도민 멤버십 카드’다. 쇼핑·문화·교통뿐만 아니라 공영 주차장과 공공 시설 이용 시 할인 혜택을 이 카드 한 장에 담겠다는 구상이다. 전용 앱을 통해 걷거나 봉사 활동 등을 하면 마일리지를 적립해 현금처럼 사용할 수 있도록 하겠다고 약속했다.)

For the 4050 generation facing the dual burden of supporting parents and raising children, he proposed the "4050 Cheer Up Points," providing welfare points worth 100,000 won annually for up to three years. Health support for women is also set to expand. He announced the "Women's Health Safety Care Project," which will include free HPV (Human Papillomavirus) vaccination, as well as support for diagnosis and treatment of menopausal women and psychological counseling. (‘부모 부양과 자녀 양육’ 이중고를 겪는 4050세대에게는 연간 10만원 상당의 복지 포인트를 최대 3년간 지급하는 ‘4050 힘내라 포인트’도 제시했다. 여성 대상 건강 지원도 확대한다. HPV(인유두종바이러스) 백신 무료 접종을 포함해 갱년기 여성 진단비와 치료, 심리 상담 등을 지원하는 ‘여성 건강 안심 케어 사업’을 추진하겠다고 밝혔다.)

He also pledged to expand meal support for children during school vacations from children currently using care facilities to all dual-income households. Additionally, he outlined plans to gradually introduce youth pensions, child education pensions, senior pensions, and village pensions through "Gyeongnam Province Resident Pension Season 2" to fill income gaps across different life stages. (방학 중 아동 식사 지원은 기존 돌봄 시설 이용 아동에서 맞벌이 가정 전체로 확대하겠다고도 공약했다. ‘경남도민연금 시즌2’를 통해 청년연금, 자녀교육연금, 시니어연금, 마을연금 등을 단계적으로 도입해 생애 주기별 소득 공백을 보완하겠다는 구상도 밝혔다.)

He also proposed the "Resident Happiness Fund," worth 100 billion won annually, which will serve as the financial foundation for implementing these pledges. The plan is to secure a total of 400 billion won over the four-year term of the 9th popularly elected government by utilizing reclaimed public development profits, private development public contributions, public energy revenue, and regional investment funds. Candidate Park stated, "The direction of Gyeongnam-style welfare is for the government to actively intervene in areas that do not benefit from economic growth," adding, "Filling in the shadows of growth is the core of this pledge." (공약 이행을 위한 재원의 기반이 될 연간 1000억원 규모의 ‘도민행복기금’도 제시했다. 공공 개발 이익 환수, 민간 개발 공공 기여, 공공 에너지 수익, 지역 투자 펀드 등을 활용해 민선 9기 4년간 총 4000억원을 마련하겠다는 계획이다. 박 후보는 “경제 성장의 혜택이 닿지 않는 곳에 재정이 적극 개입하는 것이 경남형 복지의 방향”이라며 “성장의 그늘을 메우는 것이 이번 공약의 핵심”이라고 했다.)

Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyoung-soo announced his fourth pledge, part of a series focused on resolving everyday life issues. On the same day, Kim presented the "Full-scale Expansion of Gyeongnam AI Voice Care Services" as the fourth pledge in his "Scratching Where It Itches" series. (더불어민주당 김경수 후보는 생활 문제를 직접 해결하는 ‘생활 밀착형’ 네 번째 공약을 발표했다. 김 후보는 이날 ‘가려운 곳부터 착착’ 시리즈의 4호 공약으로 ‘경남 인공지능(AI) 음성 돌봄 서비스 전면 확대’를 제시했다.)

This system involves distributing AI devices to the homes of vulnerable groups, such as elderly people living alone and the visually impaired, to check on their well-being. If any abnormalities are detected, it immediately connects them to 119 emergency services or a social worker. Beneficiaries include the 65+ elderly population, which makes up 22% of Gyeongnam's total population, 17,000 visually impaired individuals, and 150,000 elderly people living alone. The strategy is to use advanced technology to fill the care gaps in rural farming and fishing communities, where there is a severe shortage of manpower. The plan is said to have been developed by reflecting field proposals, including those from the Korea Senior Citizens Association's Information Business Group. (독거노인과 시각장애인 등 돌봄 취약 계층의 가정에 AI 기기를 보급해 안부를 확인하고, 이상 징후가 포착되면 즉시 119나 복지사에게 연결하는 시스템이다. 경남 전체 22%를 차지하는 65세 고령 인구, 1만7000명의 시각 장애인, 15만명의 독거노인 등이 수혜 대상이다. 인력 부족이 심각한 농어촌 지역의 돌봄 공백을 첨단 기술로 메울 수 있다는 전략이 담겨 있다. 대한노인회 정보화사업단 등 현장 제안을 반영해 마련한 공약이라고 한다.)

Candidate Kim stated, "We will create a Gyeongnam where a single word connects you to 119, and where you are not alone even if you are alone," adding, "AI care will be the warmest technology and a solid safety net." (김 후보는 “말 한마디로 119에 연결되고, 혼자 있어도 혼자가 아닌 경남을 만들겠다”며 “AI 돌봄은 가장 따뜻한 기술이자, 든든한 안전망이 될 것”이라고 했다.)

The first pledge in Kim's "Scratching Where It Itches" series was "Go, Manager Kim," centered on operating a life-oriented complaint response unit that resolves everyday inconveniences for struggling neighbors in the field. The second was "Gyeongnam-style Pet Insurance," designed to reduce the burden of pet medical costs. Its core is expanding pet insurance, currently offered to households adopting stray dogs, to all cities and counties in Gyeongnam, and establishing a system to automatically register the adoption of stray dogs. The third pledge was "Zero Pedestrian Obstruction," aimed at solving the problem of illegally abandoned Personal Mobility (PM) devices. (김 후보는 ‘가려운 곳부터 착착’ 시리즈 1호로, 어려운 이웃의 생활 불편을 현장에서 해결하는 생활 밀착 민원 기동대 운영을 중심으로 한 ‘김반장이 간다’를 공개했다. 2호는 반려동물 의료비 부담을 줄여주는 ‘경남형 펫보험’이다. 유기견 입양 가구에 지원하는 펫보험을 경남 전 시군으로 확대하고, 유기견 입양을 자동으로 등록하는 시스템 구축이 골자다. 3호는 개인형 이동 장치(PM) 무단 방치를 해결하는 ‘보행 방해 제로’다.)

Earlier, on the 27th, candidate Kim held a press conference at the Gyeongnam Provincial Council and announced his first major pledge, centered on the axes of "Restoring the Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam Mega City" and "Gyeongnam's Great Transportation Transformation." The vision is to tie Busan, Ulsan, and Gyeongnam into a single living and economic zone to create a "second capital region." (김 후보는 앞서 지난 27일 경남도의회에서 기자회견을 열고 ‘부울경 메가시티 복원’과 ‘경남 교통 대전환’을 축으로 한 1호 공약을 발표했다. 부산·울산·경남을 하나의 생활·경제권으로 묶어 ‘제2의 수도권’을 만들겠다는 구상이다.)

item.title: Opposition Moves to Dismiss Jeong Dong-young... Ruling Party Mocks Them by Taking Photos and Walking Out (野가 정동영 해임 건의하자... 與, 조롱하듯 사진 찍고 퇴장)
item.description:
Opposition Moves to Dismiss Jeong Dong-young... Ruling Party Mocks Them by Taking Photos and Walking Out (野가 정동영 해임 건의하자... 與, 조롱하듯 사진 찍고 퇴장)

As the National Assembly convened on the 28th to discuss the motion to dismiss Unification Minister Jeong Dong-young, proposed by the People Power Party (PPP), Democratic Party (DP) lawmakers staged a collective walkout. Some DP members even ignored a PPP lawmaker speaking from the podium and took commemorative photos instead. (국민의힘이 발의한 정동영 통일부 장관 해임 건의안이 28일 국회 본회의에서 논의되고 있는 상황에서 더불어민주당 의원들이 집단 퇴장하는 일이 벌어졌다. 민주당 일부 의원들은 단상에서 국민의힘 의원이 발언하는 것을 무시하고 기념 사진을 찍기도 했다.)

All 107 PPP lawmakers proposed the dismissal motion against Minister Jeong on the 24th. The reason cited was that during a plenary session of the National Assembly's Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee on the 6th of last month, Jeong mentioned "Guseong in North Pyongan Province" as a site for North Korea's uranium enrichment facilities, in addition to the previously known locations of Yongbyon in North Pyongan Province and Gangsun in Nampo, thereby leaking confidential information. The U.S. had been providing South Korea with intelligence on North Korea collected via reconnaissance assets such as satellites, surveillance, and spy planes, but after Jeong's remarks, it suspended the provision of some information. This suggests that the U.S. judged that Jeong had leaked confidential intelligence it had gathered. (국민의힘 의원 107명 전원은 지난 24일 정 장관 해임 건의안을 발의했다. 정 장관이 지난달 6일 국회 외교통일위원회 전체회의에서 북한의 우라늄 농축 시설 소재지로 기존에 알려진 평북 영변과 남포 강선 외에 ‘평북 구성’을 언급해 기밀을 유출했다는 것이 이유였다. 미국은 그동안 위성·감청·정찰기 같은 정찰 자산으로 수집한 대북 정보를 한국에 제공해왔으나, 정 장관 발언 이후로 일부 정보의 제공을 중단했다. 미국이 자국이 수집한 기밀 정보를 정 장관이 누설한 것으로 판단한 것으로 볼 수 있다.)

The PPP also cited as grounds that Minister Jeong unilaterally announced the restoration of the September 19 inter-Korean military agreement, which North Korea had scrapped; echoed North Korea's "hostile two-state theory" by advocating for "peaceful two states"; and pushed for the resumption of inter-Korean economic cooperation, calling these moves a "unilateral and submissive North Korea policy." The PPP also argued that Jeong promoted a bill to arbitrarily limit the jurisdiction of the United Nations Command within the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) and frequently expressed personal views on North Korea-related matters without coordinating with the National Security Office, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, or the Ministry of National Defense, all of which were presented as reasons for the dismissal motion. (국민의힘은 정 장관이 북한이 파기한 9·19 남북 군사 합의를 일방 복원하겠다고 발표하고, 북한의 ‘적대적 두 국가론’에 보조를 맞춰 ‘평화적 두 국가’를 주장했으며, 남북 경제 협력 재개를 추진하는 등 “일방적·굴종적 대북 정책”을 추진했다는 것도 이유로 들었다. 국민의힘은 정 장관이 비무장지대(DMZ) 안에서 유엔군사령부의 관할권을 임의로 제한하는 법안을 추진하고, 국가안보실이나 외교부, 국방부와의 조율 없이 북한 관련 사안에 대해 개인적인 견해를 말하고 다닌다고 주장하면서, 이 또한 해임 건의 이유로 들었다.)

The motion to dismiss Minister Jeong was reported to the plenary session on this day, the first such session held after its proposal in accordance with the National Assembly Act. However, with no other plenary sessions scheduled until the 1st of next month, the motion was set to be automatically discarded under a provision of the National Assembly Act, which states that a dismissal motion not put to a vote within 24 to 72 hours after being reported to a plenary session is considered nullified. (정 장관 해임 건의안은 국회법에 따라 발의된 후 처음 열리는 본회의인 이날 본회의에 보고됐다. 다만 다음 달 1일까지 다른 본회의가 열릴 예정이 없어, ‘본회의에 보고된 때부터 24시간 이후 72시간 이내에 표결하지 않은 해임 건의안은 폐기된 것으로 본다’는 국회법 조항에 따라서 자동 폐기될 상황이었다.)

Lawmaker Kim Geon, the secretary of the National Assembly's Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee, requested a free speech session during the plenary to verbally explain the intent behind the PPP's dismissal motion against Minister Jeong. As Kim began speaking, DP lawmakers started leaving the chamber. Some of them took commemorative photos among themselves with Kim behind them, primarily featuring lawmakers resigning from the National Assembly to run as candidates for provincial governors in the June 3 local elections. After Kim concluded his remarks, National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik declared the session adjourned. (국회 외교통일위원회 간사인 김건 의원은 이날 본회의에서 자유 발언을 청해, 국민의힘이 정 장관 해임 건의안을 낸 취지를 구두로 설명했다. 김 의원이 발언을 시작하자 민주당 의원들은 본회의장에서 퇴장하기 시작했다. 일부 의원은 김 의원을 뒤로한 채 자기들끼리 기념사진을 찍었다. 6·3 지방선거에 시·도지사 후보로 출마하기 위해 국회의원을 사퇴하는 의원들이 주축이 돼 남기는 사진이었다. 김 의원이 발언을 마치자 우원식 국회의장이 산회를 선포했다.)

PPP floor leader Song Eon-seok posted on Facebook, stating, "The PPP strongly demanded that a plenary session be held on the 27th to report the dismissal motion and hold a vote today, but Speaker Woo and the DP ignored this and committed a 'nullification trick' by reporting it at today's session." Song added, "What is the ruling party with 160 seats afraid of that it cannot even hold a vote on this dismissal motion? If they want to reject it, they could just do so—why worry and resort to such tricks to nullify it?" He further questioned, "Even if the dismissal motion passes, it has no binding force, and President Lee Jae-myung could refuse to dismiss him. How can we understand this trick of not even allowing a vote?" (국민의힘 송언석 원내대표는 페이스북에 글을 올려 “국민의힘은 27일 본회의를 열어 해임 건의안을 보고하고 오늘 본회의에서 표결하자고 강력하게 요구했는데, 우 의장과 민주당은 이를 묵살하고 오늘 본회의에 보고하는 ‘폐기 꼼수’를 저질렀다”고 했다. 송 원내대표는 “160석 거대 여당이 뭐가 두려워서 해임 건의안을 표결도 못 한다는 말이냐”라며 “부결시키면 될 것을, 뭐가 걱정돼서 이런 꼼수로 폐기시킨다는 말이냐”라고 했다. “해임 건의안이 통과된다 한들, 강제력이 없어서 이재명 대통령이 해임을 거부할 수도 있는데, 도대체 표결도 못 하겠다는 꼼수를 어떻게 이해할 수 있겠습니까”라고 했다.)

PPP lawmaker Lee Seong-gwon wrote on Facebook, "Are the DP lawmakers in their right minds, taking commemorative photos while an opposition lawmaker speaks at the plenary session?" Lee argued, "This goes beyond disrespecting the opposition; it's a matter of the dignity and qualification of ruling party lawmakers responsible for state affairs. Today's behavior by the DP is not just disqualifying but a reckless act that damages the national stature of the Republic of Korea." (국민의힘 이성권 의원은 페이스북에서 “야당 의원이 본회의장에서 발언하는데 기념 촬영을 하는 민주당 의원들은 제정신이냐”고 했다. 이 의원은 “야당에 대한 무시 차원을 넘어, 국정을 책임지는 여당 의원들의 품격과 자격의 문제”라며 “오늘 민주당의 태도는 자격 미달을 넘어, 대한민국의 국격을 훼손시킨 망동”이라고 주장했다.)

item.title: "Why Only Lee Hwa-young Gets Heavy Sentence" As Party Points Out, Kim Seong-tae Responds "Mostly Due to Bribery Charges" (“왜 이화영만 중형” 與 지적에 김성태 “뇌물 혐의가 대부분”)
item.description:
"Why Only Lee Hwa-young Gets Heavy Sentence" As Party Points Out, Kim Seong-tae Responds "Mostly Due to Bribery Charges" (“왜 이화영만 중형” 與 지적에 김성태 “뇌물 혐의가 대부분”)

Former Ssangbangwool Chairman Kim Seong-tae responded on the 28th to the Democratic Party of Korea's claim that "As a result of collusion between Ssangbangwool and the prosecution, only former Gyeonggi Province Deputy Governor for Peace Lee Hwa-young received a heavy sentence in the North Korea remittance case" by stating that "most of Lee's sentence is due to bribery charges." (김성태 전 쌍방울 회장이 28일 ‘쌍방울이 검찰과 결탁한 결과 대북송금 사건에서 이화영 전 경기도 평화부지사만 중형을 선고받았다’는 더불어민주당 주장에 “이씨 형량 대부분은 뇌물 혐의 때문”이라는 취지로 답했다.)

Kim appeared as a witness that day at a comprehensive hearing of the National Assembly's special committee on 'Suspicions of fabricated indictments by the Yoon Seok-yeol regime' led by the Democratic Party, regarding the Ssangbangwool North Korea remittance case. He made this statement in response to a question from Democratic Party aide Park Seong-joon, who asked, "Isn't it the case that former Ssangbangwool Vice Chairman Bang Yong-cheol colluded with the prosecution and received a relatively light punishment?" Bang, who had testified at a hearing on the 14th that "In July 2019, I met North Korean agent Ri Ho-nam in the Philippines and handed over $700,000 under the pretext of expenses for President Lee Jae-myung's visit to North Korea," was a figure who made damaging testimony against the Democratic Party. <<> On that day, Representative Park asked, "Bang Yong-cheol and Lee Hwa-young are co-conspirators, yet Bang received suspended sentences for violations of the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act and the National Security Act. Lee received 7 years and 8 months. Wouldn't you think Bang colluded with the prosecution?" In response, Kim said, "Deputy Governor Lee got 6 years for bribery and 1 year and 6 months for the Foreign Exchange Management Act. For the bribery, I am the principal offender, and Bang Yong-cheol is an accessory." This suggests that Lee received a heavy sentence because he accepted bribes from Ssangbangwool, while Bang received a relatively light sentence because he merely delivered the bribes under Kim's orders. <<> When Representative Park pressed further, saying, "The prosecution targeted the weakest points of Lee Hwa-young, Bang Yong-cheol, and Ahn Bu-soo (former president of the Asia-Pacific Peace Exchange Association) against Kim Seong-tae. Isn't the core of the Ssangbangwool case that the prosecution colluded with hostile forces through coercion and persuasion?" Kim replied, "I cannot agree with your statement." <<> Kim added, "Bang Yong-cheol had no reason to collude with the prosecution. He was simply a bribe provider. Since I ordered the money to be given, Bang received a suspended sentence, while I was sentenced to 2 years in prison." <<> However, Kim's claim that "Lee Hwa-young received 6 years for bribery and 1 year and 6 months for the Foreign Exchange Management Act" differs somewhat from the actual trial outcome. Previously, the Supreme Court confirmed Lee's sentence of 7 years for bribery and violations of the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act, and an additional 8 months for violations of the Political Funds Act. Lee was found guilty of receiving approximately 320 million won in bribes and political funds from Ssangbangwool. <<> During the parliamentary investigation that day, Kim also denied the Democratic Party's allegations of a 'salmon drinking party,' stating, "I didn't drink alcohol." (김씨는 이날 더불어민주당이 주도하는 국회 ‘윤석열 정권 조작 기소 의혹 사건 국정조사’ 특별위원회의 쌍방울 대북 송금 사건 관련 종합 청문회에 증인으로 출석해 “방용철 전 쌍방울 부회장이 검찰과 결탁해 비교적 낮은 처벌을 받은 것 아니냐”는 박성준 민주당 간사의 질문에 이같이 밝혔다. 방 전 부회장은 지난 14일 청문회에서 “2019년 7월 필리핀에서 북한 공작원 리호남을 만나 이재명 대통령 방북 비용 명목으로 70만 달러를 건넸다”고 민주당에 불리한 증언을 했던 인물이다.)

item.title: Kim Seong-tae: "Salmon drinking party? I didn't eat it"... Denies allegations of coaxing at special parliamentary committee hearing (김성태 “연어 술파티? 안 먹었다”... 국조특위 청문회서 회유 의혹 부인)
item.description:
Kim Seong-tae: "Salmon drinking party? I didn't eat it"... Denies allegations of coaxing at special parliamentary committee hearing (김성태 “연어 술파티? 안 먹었다”... 국조특위 청문회서 회유 의혹 부인)

Former Chairman of Ssangbangwool, Kim Seong-tae, said on the 28th regarding the so-called "salmon drinking party coaxing allegations," "I'm nearly 60 years old, so please stop talking about what I eat," adding, "I clearly state that on May 17, I definitely did not drink alcohol." (김성태 전 쌍방울 회장이 28일 이른바 ‘연어 술 파티 회유 의혹’에 대해 “제가 나이가 60에 가까운데 이제 먹는 것 가지고 그만 좀 말해달라”며 “분명히 말씀드리지만 저는 5월 17일 정확히 술 안 먹었다”고 했다.)

Kim appeared as a witness at the comprehensive hearing of the National Assembly's special committee on the parliamentary investigation into the allegations of manipulated indictments by the Yoon Seok-yeol administration, led by the Democratic Party of Korea, regarding the Ssangbangwool remittance to North Korea case. He made this statement in response to a question from People Power Party lawmaker Kwak Kyu-taek, who asked, "Did you drink soju inside the prosecution office?" (김 전 회장은 이날 더불어민주당이 주도하는 국회 ‘윤석열 정권 조작 기소 의혹 사건 국정조사’ 특별위원회의 쌍방울 대북 송금 사건 관련 종합 청문회에 증인으로 출석해 ‘검찰청 안에서 소주를 마시고 그랬냐’는 곽규택 국민의힘 의원의 질의에 이같이 말했다.)

President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party of Korea have claimed that "the prosecution coaxed former Chairman Kim and former Vice Governor Lee Hwa-young by offering them alcohol and salmon, thereby manipulating their statements." (이재명 대통령과 더불어민주당 측에서는 “검찰이 김 전 회장과 이화영 전 부지사에게 술과 연어를 주며 회유해 진술을 조작했다”고 주장해왔다.)

Kim said, "I'm old enough—please stop talking about it," and "They say I ate salmon—what does that have to do with anything?" He added, "They say I drank coffee and that prison guards attended to me, but I go every day tied up with ropes and handcuffed for investigations—how could I be attended to? Of course, after visiting frequently, I developed a rapport with some prosecutors, so I had a few cups of coffee and got caught eating kimbap, which was embarrassing, so I didn't even eat what I could." (김 전 회장은 “제가 나이가 몇인데 그만 좀 말씀하셨으면 좋겠다”며 “연어 먹었다고 (하는데) 무슨 관계냐”고 했다. 그는 “무슨 커피를 먹었네, 교도관들이 저희들 뭐 수발을 들었다고 하는데 저도 매일 밧줄 묶이고 수갑 차고 조사받으러 가면서 무슨 수발을 받느냐”며 “물론 자주 가다 보면 검찰 직원들과 정이 들면 커피 몇 잔 먹고 (또) 김밥 먹다 걸려서 창피해서 먹을 것도 안 먹었다”고 했다.)

When Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Seung-won again asked about the "salmon drinking party coaxing allegations," he replied, "I'm telling you I didn't eat it because I truly didn't." (그는 더불어민주당 김승원 의원이 관련해서 재차 ‘연어 술 파티 회유 의혹’을 묻자 “사실 안 먹었기 때문에 안 먹었다고 말씀드리는 것”이라고 했다.)

Kim also denied questions about whether Ssangbangwool remitted money to North Korea for stock manipulation, saying, "That's entirely not true." This effectively maintained his court testimony that the $8 million was sent to North Korea on behalf of Gyeonggi Province. (김 전 회장은 쌍방울이 주가 조작을 위해 대북 송금을 했느냐는 질문에도 “전혀 사실이 아니다”라고 했다. 사실상 경기도를 위해 북한 측에 800만달러를 보냈다는 법정 진술을 그대로 유지한 것이다.)

When People Power Party lawmaker Na Kyung-won asked, "According to the frame set up by the Democratic Party and the National Intelligence Service, $5 million of the $8 million sent to North Korea was for stock manipulation—is that correct?" Kim replied, "It's entirely not true, but I can't answer further on matters related to the trial." When Na again asked, "Is it true that you knew the money was to be used for then-Gyeonggi Governor Lee Jae-myung's visit to North Korea and sent it?" he said, "I can't answer matters related to the trial." (김 전 회장은 이날 “민주당과 국정원이 짜놓은 프레임에 따르면 (김 전 회장이) 북한에 보낸 800만 불 중 500만 불은 주가 조작하기 위한 것이라는데 맞느냐”는 나경원 국민의힘 의원의 질의에 “전혀 사실이 아니지만 더 이상 재판에 관련된 것은 (답하기 어렵다)”고 말했다. 나 의원이 재차 “(당시) 이재명 경기도지사의 방북 비용에 쓰인다는 것을 알고 보낸 것을 맞느냐”고 묻자 “재판에 관련된 것은 답하기 어렵다”고 했다.)

Kim was found guilty of covering up a total of $8 million, including $3 million for the then-Gyeonggi Governor's visit to North Korea, and was sentenced to two years and six months in prison in the first trial in July 2024. He was released on bail in January and is currently standing trial without detention. (김 전 회장은 쌍방울이 이 당시 경기지사의 방북 비용(300만달러) 등 총 800만달러를 대납한 혐의가 인정돼 2024년 7월 1심에서 2년 6개월의 실형을 선고받은 이후 지난 1월 보석으로 석방돼 불구속 상태로 재판을 받고 있다.)

item.title: Rising Role Theory... Kim Moon-soo to Serve as Election Committee Chair for Busan, Daegu, North Gyeongsang, and Gangwon Regions (떠오르는 역할론...김문수, 부산·대구·경북·강원 지역 선대위원장 맡는다)
item.description:
Rising Role Theory... Kim Moon-soo to Serve as Election Committee Chair for Busan, Daegu, North Gyeongsang, and Gangwon Regions (떠오르는 역할론...김문수, 부산·대구·경북·강원 지역 선대위원장 맡는다 )

It was revealed on the 28th that former Minister of Employment and Labor Kim Moon-soo of the People Power Party has taken on the role of honorary election committee chair for Daegu, following his appointment in Busan. Amid calls from People Power Party candidates for Representative Jang Dong-hyuk to step down to a second-line role, the former Minister Kim's role is emerging as a key factor. (국민의힘 김문수 전 고용노동부 장관이 부산에 이어 대구 지역 명예선대위원장을 맡은 것으로 28일 나타났다. 국민의힘 후보들이 장동혁 대표의 ‘2선퇴진’을 요구하는 가운데 김 전 장관의 역할론이 부상하는 형국이다.)

Rep. Choo Kyung-ho, who was selected as the People Power Party candidate for Daegu mayor, stated on the same day, "The People Power Party candidates for local government heads in Daegu and North Gyeongsang are seeking a conservative grand coalition through a joint election committee." He added, "To immediately establish a campaign structure capable of field operations, we have appointed former Minister Kim, who was the party's candidate in the last presidential election, as honorary election committee chair." (국민의힘 대구시장 후보로 선출된 추경호 의원 측은 이날 “국민의힘 대구·경북 단체장 후보들이 공동선대위 구성으로 보수 총결집을 꾀하고 있다”면서 “당장 현장 투입이 가능한 선거캠프 체제 구성을 위해 직전 대선후보였던 김 전 장관을 명예선대위원장으로 위촉했다”고 밝혔다.)

He continued, "In the last presidential election, the People Power Party and candidate Kim Moon-soo made an earnest appeal to prevent the foundation of the nation from being shaken by the Democratic Party's legislative dictatorship followed by its takeover of the executive branch," and noted, "The citizens of Daegu also showed overwhelming support with 67.62% of the vote." Former Minister Kim is from Yeongcheon, North Gyeongsang Province, and is a graduate of Daegu Gyeongbuk High School. (그러면서 “지난 대선에서도 국민의힘과 김문수 후보는 민주당의 입법 독재에 이은 행정부 장악으로 나라의 근간이 흔들리는 것 만은 막아달라는 간절한 호소를 드린 바 있다”며 “대구시민도 67.62% 라는 압도적인 성원을 보냈다”고 했다. 김 전 장관은 경북 영천 출신에 대구 경북고를 졸업했다.)

Prior to this, Busan Mayor Park Hyung-joon also appointed former Minister Kim as honorary election committee chair for the Busan region. A spokesperson for Mayor Park stated, "This reflects our determination to defend Busan as the last bulwark against one-party dominance and soft dictatorship." Mayor Park also appointed former National Assembly Speaker Chung Ui-hwa as a co-honorary chair alongside former Minister Kim. (이보다 앞서 박형준 부산시장도 김 전 장관을 부산 지역 명예선대위원장으로 추대했다. 박 시장 측은 “일당 독주와 연성 독재를 막는 마지막 방파제인 부산을 사수하겠다는 의지를 담았다”고 밝혔다. 박 시장은 김 전 장관과 함께 정의화 전 국회의장도 공동 명예 위원장으로 위촉했다.)

It is reported that former Minister Kim has also received and accepted a request to serve as election committee chair for the Gangwon region, in addition to Busan and Daegu. The election committees, independently organized by candidates for metropolitan and provincial governors, are extending a love call to former Minister Kim. This stands in stark contrast to Representative Jang Dong-hyuk, who faces calls for resignation. Representative Jang has dismissed the resignation demands, stating, "Stepping down as party leader just because the situation is unfavorable is not responsible politics." However, voices among the candidates are growing louder, urging him to "make a decision on his own." (김 전 장관은 부산·대구뿐만 아니라 강원 지역 선대위에서도 선대위원장직 요청을 받고 수락한 것으로 알려졌다. 시·도지사 후보들이 독자적으로 구성하는 선대위에서 김 전 장관에게 러브콜을 보내는 것이다. 이는 사퇴론에 직면한 장동혁 대표와는 대조적인 모습이다. 장 대표는 “상황이 좋지 않다고 당대표에서 물러나는 것은 책임지는 정치가 아니다”라고 사퇴론을 일축했지만, 후보들을 중심으로 “스스로 결단해야 한다”는 목소리가 커지고 있다.)

Earlier, Seoul Mayor Candidate Oh Se-hoon said, "The time has come for reflection or a decision." He added, "It would actually help in conducting the election if (Representative Jang) reduces his scope of activities." Gangwon Governor Candidate Kim Jin-tae stated, "Representative Jang needs to resolve the situation he created," and Daegu Mayor Candidate Choo Kyung-ho also remarked, "From now on, it's the candidates' time," emphasizing, "From this perspective, the party leadership should also consider election strategies." (앞서 오세훈 서울시장 후보는 “이제 자숙이나 결단이 필요한 시점이 왔다”며 “(장 대표가) 활동 반경을 줄여주시는 게 오히려 선거를 치르는 데 도움이 된다”고 했다. 김진태 강원지사 후보는 “장 대표의 결자해지가 필요하다”고 했고, 추경호 대구시장 후보 또한 “지금부터는 후보들의 시간”이라며 “이런 관점에서 당 지도부도 선거 전략을 고민해야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Busan Buk-gu Preliminary Battle? Han Dong-hoon: "Did President Lee Order the Candidacy?" Ha Jung-woo: "I Persuaded 'Boss'" (부산 북갑 전초전? 한동훈 “李대통령, 출마지시 했나” 하정우 “제가 ‘통님’ 설득”)
item.description:
Busan Buk-gu Preliminary Battle? Han Dong-hoon: "Did President Lee Order the Candidacy?" Ha Jung-woo: "I Persuaded 'Boss'" (부산 북갑 전초전? 한동훈 “李대통령, 출마지시 했나” 하정우 “제가 ‘통님’ 설득” )

Former People Power Party leader Han Dong-hoon publicly questioned on the 28th, targeting former presidential secretary for AI future strategy Ha Jung-woo, asking, "Did President Lee Jae-myung order you to run in the Busan Buk-gu by-election?" In response, former secretary Ha refuted, saying, "I persuaded the Boss (President Lee Jae-myung)." The two are expected to face off in the Busan Buk-gu National Assembly by-election, which will be held alongside the June 3 local elections. (한동훈 전 국민의힘 대표가 하정우 전 청와대 AI미래기획수석을 겨냥해 “이재명 대통령이 부산 북갑 보궐선거에 출마하라고 지시했나”라고 28일 공개 질의했다. 그러자 하 전 수석은 “제가 통님(이재명 대통령)을 설득한 것”이라고 반박했다. 두 사람은 6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에서 맞붙을 것으로 전망된다.)

On that day, Han wrote on Facebook, "I ask former secretary Ha and the presidential office: Is it true that President Lee ordered former secretary Ha to run in the Busan Buk-gu National Assembly by-election?" (한 전 대표는 이날 페이스북에 “하 전 수석과 청와대에 묻는다. 이 대통령이 한 전 수석에게 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마를 지시한 것이 맞느냐”고 썼다.)

Earlier, while weighing a run in the Busan Buk-gu by-election, former secretary Ha had stated, "I will only run if President Lee Jae-myung tells me to run for Busan Buk-gu; otherwise, I will stay in the presidential office." Referring to Ha's remarks, Han said, "Now that he's running, it seems President Lee ordered him to," and added, "If so, it's illegal election interference by President Lee." According to Han, if President Lee intervened in Ha's candidacy, it would violate the neutrality obligation of public officials stipulated in the Public Official Election Act. <<> In response, former secretary Ha said, "I persuaded the Boss. (President Lee) agreed with my opinion and readily accepted it," adding, "(President Lee) told me to work hard for the national interest wherever I go." He then stated, "It wasn't the Boss's order; I persuaded him, so it can't be election interference," and said, "There's no need to be swayed by such far-fetched logic." (앞서 하 전 수석을 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 출마를 고심하면서 “이재명 대통령이 부산 북갑에 출마하라고 해야 출마할거고, 아니면 청와대에 남겠다”고 했던 바 있다. 한 전 대표는 하 전 수석의 이 발언을 언급하면서 “이제 출마하는 것을 보니 이 대통령이 지시한 것으로 보인다”며 “그렇다면 이 대통령의 불법 선거개입”이라고 했다. 이 대통령이 하 전 수석의 출마에 개입했다면 공직선거법에 명시된 공무원의 중립 의무를 위반했다는 것이다.)

On the same day, Han reiterated, "When I pointed out that it would be illegal election interference if President Lee ordered the candidacy, former secretary Ha changed his story, saying, 'I persuaded the Boss, so it's not election interference.'" He added, "It's a problem if Ha himself wanted to run but lied using President Lee as an excuse, and it's also a problem if President Lee illegally ordered the candidacy and they lied to cover it up." (이에 하 전 수석은 “제가 통님을 설득했다. (이 대통령은) 제 의견에 동의하시고 흔쾌히 수락했다”며 “(이 대통령은) 어디서든 국익을 위해 힘쓰라 하셨다”고 했다. 이어 “통님 지시가 아니고 제가 설득한 것이니 선거 개입이 될 수 없다”며 “억지 논리에 일희일비할 필요가 없다”고 했다.)

Regarding Ha's deliberation over running in Busan Buk-gu, Han also said in a media interview, "Why should the entire nation have to watch for an entire month while former secretary Ha seeks permission from 'Daddy' (the President)?" He added, "This election is a proxy war with President Lee, and I will thoroughly expose the government's failings." (한 전 대표는 같은 날 재차 “제가 이 대통령이 출마하라고 지시했다면 불법 선거 개입이라고 지적하자, 하 전 수석은 ‘통님을 설득했으니 선거 개입이 아니다’라고 말을 바꿨다”고 했다. 이어 “하 전 수석 본인이 출마하고 싶은데도 이 대통령 핑계 대며 거짓말을 했어도 문제이고, 이 대통령이 불법 출마 지시를 했음에도 아닌 것처럼 거짓말해도 문제”라고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Seong-tae: "The Ruling Party is Emptying Everything... Just Like the Yoon Administration" (김성태 “與, 있는 것 없는 것 다 털어…尹 정권과 똑같아”)
item.description:
Kim Seong-tae: "The Ruling Party is Emptying Everything... Just Like the Yoon Administration" (김성태 “與, 있는 것 없는 것 다 털어…尹 정권과 똑같아”)

Former Ssangbangwool Chairman Kim Seong-tae said on the 28th, in response to the Democratic Party of Korea and the Financial Supervisory Service’s claim that "The $8 million sent by Ssangbangwool to North Korea was for stock manipulation," that "It seems like you're doing the same thing as the Yoon Seok-yeol administration." This came after he denied the 'salmon drinking party' allegations during a parliamentary investigation, prompting the ruling party and government to bring up the need to investigate Ssangbangwool's stock manipulation, pressuring him. <<> Kim appeared as a witness at the general hearing on the Ssangbangwool North Korea remittance case held by the National Assembly's special committee for the 'Suspected Manipulated Indictment Case of the Yoon Seok-yeol Administration,' led by the Democratic Party. In response to a question from Democratic Party lawmaker Jeon Yong-ki, who said, "It was the last chance to clarify the (salmon drinking party) details, which is unfortunate," Kim made the statement. <<> Kim said to the Democratic Party, "The world has changed, but why can't we say that I have no relationship with Lee Hwa-young (former Vice Governor of Gyeonggi Province for Peace)?" adding, "If I say anything, you think it's all lies." Earlier that day, during the parliamentary investigation, Kim had completely denied the 'drinking party' allegations claimed by Lee Hwa-young, saying, "I never drank." Democratic Party lawmakers pointed out that this amounted to Kim giving false testimony. <<> Kim stated, "When you Democratic Party lawmakers say 'they manipulated stock prices,' (FSS Governor) Lee Chan-jin is digging up everything, whether there's something or nothing. I'm sorry, but it seems like you're doing the same as what the Yoon Seok-yeol administration did before. Either way, I can be investigated once, get stripped clean, and even go to prison, but lawmakers shouldn't do that. A careless stone can kill a passing frog." Kim continued, "Right now, with just one word from you lawmakers, my company has been delisted, and small shareholders are dying. Why are you suddenly digging up everything about stock manipulation?" <<> When Special Committee Chair Seo Young-kyo asked, "Are you under investigation for stock manipulation right now?" Kim shouted, "The FSS Governor was a lawyer for the North Korea remittance case back then. Isn't he holding a grudge against me? Do as you please! If there's anything to dig up, go ahead and dig it all up, and drive me to the death!" This was in reference to FSS Governor Lee Chan-jin, who had been a lawyer for President Lee Jae-myung in the Ssangbangwool North Korea remittance case, allegedly holding negative feelings toward Kim for testifying unfavorably against President Lee and continuing to raise suspicions of 'Ssangbangwool stock manipulation.' <<> During the parliamentary investigation that day, regarding the Democratic Party's claim that the $8 million Ssangbangwool illegally provided to North Korea in 2019 was for boosting or manipulating Ssangbangwool's stock prices, rather than being 'Lee Jae-myung's Gyeonggi Governor visit to North Korea expenses,' Kim said, "That's completely not true." On the other hand, the Financial Supervisory Service takes the stance that the prosecution received evidence of Ssangbangwool stock manipulation but conducted a lenient investigation. (김성태 전 쌍방울 회장은 ‘쌍방울이 북한에 보낸 800만달러는 주가 조작 용도’라는 더불어민주당과 금융감독원을 향해 “윤석열 정권과 똑같이 하시는 것 같다”고 28일 말했다. 자신이 국정조사에서 ‘연어 술 파티’ 의혹을 부인하자, 여당과 정부가 쌍방울 주가조작 수사 필요성을 언급하며 자신을 압박하고 있다는 것이다.)

item.title: Cho Kuk Party Lashes Out at ‘Cho Kuk Sniper’ Kim Yong-nam’s Nomination (조국당, ‘조국 저격수’ 김용남 공천받자 맹폭)
item.description:
Cho Kuk Party Lashes Out at ‘Cho Kuk Sniper’ Kim Yong-nam’s Nomination (조국당, ‘조국 저격수’ 김용남 공천받자 맹폭)

When the Democratic Party of Korea nominated former Saenuri Party lawmaker Kim Yong-nam for the June 3 by-election in Pyeongtaek Gap, Gyeonggi Province—where Cho Kuk, leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, is also running—the Cho Kuk Innovation Party pushed back. They argue that putting forward Kim, who was dubbed the ‘Cho Kuk sniper’ during the ‘Cho Kuk scandal,’ as Cho’s rival candidate is “inconsistent with political decency.” Kim, a former prosecutor, had fiercely criticized the suspicions surrounding a private equity fund involving Cho’s family at the time. <<> Rep. Kang Kyung-sook of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party posted on Facebook on the 28th, describing Kim as “a figure who has been at the center of controversy multiple times” and “has shown abrupt shifts in political stance and crude attacks on opponents.” This criticizes Kim for having served as a lawmaker under a party affiliated with the People Power Party in the past before joining the Democratic Party. Lawmaker Jeong Chun-saeng of the same party also said the previous day, “Kim was aligned with the political prosecutors who hunted Cho Kuk,” asking, “Is the Democratic Party, which nominated the ‘Cho Kuk sniper,’ truly our ally that co-built the Lee Jae-myung government?” Lawmaker Shin Jang-sik added, “Kim should start by writing a letter of apology.” <<> However, the Democratic Party maintains the stance that the nomination is “not at all inappropriate,” rejecting claims of an ‘unfit nomination.’ Secretary-General Cho Seung-rae appeared on a radio program on the same day, saying, “I’m not sure how bringing up the old Cho Kuk scandal would help Representative Cho.” Former lawmaker Kim Yong-nam also stated, “Regarding the Cho family’s private equity fund, the more we talk about it, the more disadvantageous it becomes for Representative Cho.” <<> In political circles, some interpreted this as “the possibility of a unified candidate between Kim and Cho within the broader opposition camp fading away.” Yet, others suggest that “adjustments for unification will be made later in the campaign based on trends in opposition candidates’ approval ratings.” Five candidates are currently running in this district: Kim, former People Power Party lawmaker Yoo Eui-dong, Cho, Progressive Party leader Kim Jae-yeon, and Liberty and Innovation Party leader Hwang Kyo-ahn. On the possibility of unification, Kim said, “It’s not at a stage to discuss it as a primary goal,” while adding, “I’m open to it.” Cho also noted, “I believe the public does not want an artificial unification,” but added, “I think wise citizens of Pyeongtaek will naturally make their own judgment.” (더불어민주당이 조국 조국혁신당 대표가 출마한 6·3 경기 평택을 재선거에 김용남 전 새누리당 의원을 공천하자, 조국혁신당이 반발하고 나섰다. ‘조국 사태’ 당시 ‘조국 저격수’로 불렸던 김 전 의원을 조 대표의 경쟁 후보로 내세운 것은 “정치적 상도의에 맞지 않는다”는 주장이다. 검사 출신인 김 전 의원은 당시 조 대표 가족을 둘러싼 사모펀드 의혹을 강하게 비판했었다.)

item.title: “Look at Me, a Conservative, Not the Democratic Party Banner” (“민주당 간판 대신 보수주의자인 나를 봐달라”)
item.description:
“Look at Me, a Conservative, Not the Democratic Party Banner” (“민주당 간판 대신 보수주의자인 나를 봐달라”)

In an interview with this newspaper on the 23rd, Kim Sang-wook, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Ulsan mayor, stated, “I will not ask you to vote for the Democratic Party as a party,” adding, “Please vote for me, Kim Sang-wook, the person who will work for Ulsan.” (더불어민주당 김상욱 울산시장 후보는 지난 23일 본지 인터뷰에서 “민주당이라는 당을 뽑아달라고 호소하지 않겠다”며 “울산을 위해 일할 사람인 저, 김상욱을 뽑아달라”고 말했다.)

Candidate Kim was elected in the 2024 general election under the People Power Party banner for Ulsan’s Nam-gu district. However, after supporting the impeachment of former President Yoon Suk Yeol, he backed President Lee Jae-myung in the last presidential election. Nonetheless, Kim emphasized, “I am a conservative.” He explained, “The People Power Party has become an anti-conservative party,” and “I joined the Democratic Party because it showed efforts to act as a responsible party and fulfill conservative functions.” (김 후보는 2024년 총선 때 국민의힘 간판으로 울산 남갑에서 당선됐지만 윤석열 전 대통령 탄핵에 찬성한 뒤 지난 대선 때 이재명 대통령을 지지했다. 하지만 김 후보는 “저는 보수주의자”라고 강조했다. 그는 “국민의힘은 반(反)보수 정당의 모습”이라며 “민주당이 책임 정당으로서 보수의 기능을 하려고 노력하는 모습을 보였기 때문에 입당한 것”이라고 했다.)

Regarding his reason for running for mayor, Kim said, “Ulsan has become a place where young people and businesses are leaving,” and “If Ulsan does not change now, it will collapse in three years in the face of the AX (AI transformation) wave. I am determined to change Ulsan.” He proposed policies such as having a funding company owned by citizens and workers own physical AI robots like Boston Dynamics’ ‘Atlas.’ On the issue of unification with Jinbo Party candidate Kim Jong-hoon, he stated, “Unification is the will of Ulsan citizens,” and “Regardless of election outcomes or party interests, unification must happen.” (김 후보는 시장 출마 이유에 대해선 “지금 울산은 청년이 떠나고, 기업이 떠나는 곳이 됐다”며 “울산이 지금 변하지 않는다면 3년 후엔 AX(인공지능 전환)라는 파고 앞에서 무너질 것이다. 꼭 울산을 변화시키겠다”고 했다. 그러면서 보스턴다이내믹스의 로봇 ‘아틀라스’와 같은 피지컬 AI(인공지능)를 시민·노동자가 출자한 펀딩회사가 소유하는 방안 등을 공약으로 제시했다. 진보당 김종훈 후보와의 단일화에 대해선 “단일화는 울산시민의 뜻”이라며 “선거 승패와 상관없이, 당리당략과 상관없이 단일화는 반드시 해야 한다”고 했다.)

-What is the reason for running, even resigning from your parliamentary seat just two years after being elected? (-국회의원 당선 2년 만에 의원직을 그만두면서까지 출마한 이유는.)

“Ulsan is both a political and psychological battleground for me. I was the People Power Party’s ‘top target for elimination,’ and in the Democratic Party, I’m still seen as an outsider. But I thought that even if Ulsan abandons me, I should not abandon Ulsan. Ulsan is the place that gave me the opportunity to pursue politics. I stepped forward with a sense of urgency to change Ulsan.” (“울산은 내게 정치적 험지이자 심리적 험지다. 국민의힘의 ‘제거 0순위’고, 민주당에선 여전히 낯선 사람으로 평가받기도 한다. 하지만 울산이 나를 버릴지언정 내가 울산을 버려선 안 된다고 생각했다. 울산은 내게 정치할 기회를 만들어준 곳이다. 울산을 바꿔야 한다는 절박감으로 나섰다.”)

-You left the People Power Party after supporting impeachment. However, in conservative circles, there has been much criticism of your joining the Democratic Party. (-탄핵에 찬성하며 국민의힘을 탈당했다. 하지만 보수 진영에선 민주당 입당에 대해 비판도 많았다.)

“I left the People Power Party because I judged it to be an anti-conservative party. It broke the constitutional order without any reflection. Its actions, which promote conflict rather than social unity, are typical of the far-right. It seemed impossible to correct. On the other hand, the Democratic Party was fulfilling what I consider the conservative function of protecting the constitutional order.” (“국민의힘을 떠난 건 반(反)보수 정당이라고 판단했기 때문이다. 헌정질서를 부수고서도 반성하지 않았다. 사회 통합이 아닌 갈등을 조장하는 모습은 전형적인 극우의 모습이다. 바로잡을 가능성이 없어 보였다. 오히려 민주당이 헌정질서 수호 등 내가 생각하는 보수의 기능을 수행하고 있었다.”)

-In polls, you are leading the incumbent mayor Kim Doo-gyeom, the People Power Party candidate. (-여론조사에서 국민의힘 후보인 김두겸 현 시장을 앞서고 있다.)

“Actually, I started with the thought that ‘the likelihood of losing is greater.’ I am grateful for the positive response from citizens. I see it as a signal that citizens, tired of four years of exhibition-style administration, want change. Ulsan citizens are pragmatic people.” (“사실 ‘질 가능성이 더 크다’는 생각으로 나섰다. 시민들 호응이 좋아서 감사한 마음이다. 지난 4년간 전시 행정에 지친 시민들이 변화를 원하고 있다는 신호라고 생각한다. 울산시민은 실용적인 사람들이다.”)

-How would you evaluate Mayor Kim’s four years of governance? (-김 시장의 4년 시정을 평가해달라.)

“He focused on visible outcomes rather than protecting citizens’ daily lives. Instead of saving the budget like his own money, he wasted it. He tried to build a bust of a businessman at a cost of 25 billion won but canceled it after criticism. He spent 7.3 billion won on the Taehwa Ru Skywalk, and many say it harms the cityscape and should be demolished.” (“시민의 일상을 지키기보다 가시적 결과에만 집중했다. 예산을 내 돈처럼 아끼는 것이 아니라 낭비했다. 250억원을 들여 기업인 흉상을 만들려고 했다가 비판이 나오자 취소했다. 태화루 스카이워크에 73억원을 썼는데 도시 경관을 해쳐 철거해야 한다는 말이 많다.”)

-What kind of Ulsan would you create if elected? (-당선된다면 어떤 울산을 만들 것인가.)

“Now, Ulsan has been taken over by vested interests rather than citizens. Although known as a wealthy city, its citizen welfare level is evaluated as worse than Busan or South Gyeongsang due to vested-interest-centered administration. People say you need to be well-connected to do business in Ulsan. Since competition based on merit is impossible, young people and businesses leave. There is a problem. Within three years, I will create a worker-centered AX model and completely transform the city.” (“지금 울산은 시민이 아닌 기득권이 주인이 돼버렸다. 부자 도시로 알려졌지만 기득권 중심 행정으로 시민 복지 수준은 부산·경남보다 못하다는 평가를 받는다. 울산에서 사업을 하려면 줄을 잘 서야 한다고들 한다. 실력으로 승부를 볼 수 없으니 청년과 기업이 떠난다. 문제가 있는 것이다. 3년 안에 노동자가 중심이 되는 AX 모델을 만들어 도시를 완전히 바꾸겠다.")

-Please explain in detail. (-자세히 설명해달라.)

“If Ulsan continues like this for just 3-4 more years, it will become a declining city. Its industrial AX will fail, and only severe labor disputes will occur. AI is replacing everything. The majority of Ulsan citizens are factory workers, and Ulsan is the place where the worry ‘Will my job exist in 10 years?’ is most immediate. AX is currently moving toward corporations and capital. We need to go beyond simply collecting a robot tax and distributing it; citizens and workers themselves must directly participate in AX and become its owners.” (“울산은 이대로 3~4년만 더 가면 쇠락하는 도시가 된다. 울산의 산업 AX는 실패하고 심각한 노사 분규만 벌어질 것이다. AI가 모든 걸 대체하고 있다. 울산시민 다수가 공장 노동자고, ‘10년 뒤 내 자리가 있을까’ 걱정이 가장 목전인 곳이 울산이다. AX가 현재 기업과 자본 중심으로 가고 있다. 단순히 로봇세를 거둬서 나눠주는 것을 넘어서 시민과 노동자가 직접 AX에 참여해 주인이 되도록 해야 한다는 것이다.”)

-The People Power Party advocates for administrative integration of Busan and South Gyeongsang but is negative about integrating Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang. (-국민의힘은 부산·경남 행정 통합을 주장하고 부산·울산·경남 통합에는 부정적이다.)

“Integration of Busan and Gyeongnam without Ulsan is incomplete. You can’t discuss the competitiveness of the southeastern region while cutting off the energy industry and manufacturing hub. Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang form one region geographically, industrially, and in terms of living areas. The People Power Party’s push to exclude Ulsan from the discussion is political neglect of Ulsan citizens. If integration of Busan and Gyeongnam directs all finances and national projects there, can businesses and citizens remain in Ulsan?” (“울산 없는 부·경 통합은 반쪽짜리다. 에너지 산업과 제조업 허브를 잘라낸 채 동남권 경쟁력을 논하는 것이다. 부·울·경은 지리적, 산업적, 생활권으로 하나의 권역이다. 국민의힘이 울산을 배제하는 방향으로 논의를 끌고 가는 것은 울산시민에 대한 정치적 홀대다. 부·경 통합으로 재정과 국가사업이 다 그쪽으로 가면 울산에 기업과 시민이 남아있을 수 있겠나.”)

-You are advocating for candidate unification with the Jinbo Party. The Jinbo Party insists that, as a condition for yielding the mayoral candidate, you should not field a candidate in the by-election for the Pyeongtaek constituency in Gyeonggi, where their leader Kim Jae-yeon is running. (-진보당과의 후보 단일화를 주장하고 있다. 진보당은 시장 후보 양보 조건으로 김재연 대표가 출마한 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 후보를 내지 말라고 주장하는데.)

“Moving according to political situations in other regions distorts the will of Ulsan citizens. It should not be framed by party interests. However, cooperation with the Jinbo Party is essential. The party leadership should take a more proactive role.” (“타 지역 정치 상황에 따라 움직이는 것은 울산시민의 의사가 왜곡되는 것이다. 당리당략으로 재단해선 안 된다. 하지만 진보당과의 연대는 꼭 필요하다. 당 지도부가 더 적극적으로 나서야 한다.”)

-The leadership, led by Chung Cheong-rae, nominated attorney Jeon Tae-jin as the candidate for the by-election in your former constituency, Ulsan Nam-gu. (-정청래 지도부가 김 후보의 지역구인 울산 남갑 보궐선거 후보로 전태진 변호사를 공천했다.)

“Nam-gu is traditionally a super-stronghold for the People Power Party. I hoped for a heavyweight figure to compensate for my shortcomings. But I respect the party’s decision and will lend my support. Currently, the most urgent need for candidate Jeon is recognition. The party needs to create opportunities for him.” (“남갑은 전통적으로 국민의힘 초강성 지지 지역이다. 내 부족함을 메울 중량감 있는 인사가 오길 원했다. 하지만 당의 결정을 존중하고 힘을 보태겠다. 지금 전 후보에게 가장 급한 것은 인지도다. 당에서 기회를 만들어 줄 필요가 있다.”)

☞Who is Kim Sang-wook (☞김상욱은 누구)

Born in 1980. Native of Uiseong, North Gyeongsang Province. Graduated from Daegu Yeongjin High School, Korea University Law School, and Pusan National University Law School. Opened a law practice in Ulsan and served as an advisory attorney for the Korean Confederation of Trade Unions Ulsan Headquarters and Nam-gu Office in Ulsan. Elected in Ulsan Nam-gu during the 2024 general election under the People Power Party’s ‘Citizen Recommendation System.’ After the December 3 martial law, he publicly supported the impeachment of then-President Yoon Suk Yeol. In May last year, a month before the presidential election, he left the People Power Party and joined the Democratic Party of Korea. (1980년생. 경북 의성 출신으로 대구 영진고, 고려대 법대, 부산대 법학전문대학원을 졸업했다. 울산에서 변호사 개업을 해 한국노총 울산본부, 울산 남구청 등 자문변호사로 활동했고, 2024년 총선 당시 국민의힘 ‘국민 추천제’로 울산 남갑에서 당선됐다. 12·3 비상계엄 이후 윤석열 당시 대통령 탄핵에 공개 찬성했고, 대선을 한 달 앞둔 작년 5월 국민의힘을 탈당한 뒤 더불어민주당에 입당했다.)

item.title: "Democratic Party and Progressive Party Must Unite or Face Certain Defeat… As a Former Lawmaker and District Mayor, I Am the Winning Candidate" (“민주·진보당, 단일화 안하면 필패… 의원·구청장 지낸 내가 승리 후보”)
item.description:
"Democratic Party and Progressive Party Must Unite or Face Certain Defeat… As a Former Lawmaker and District Mayor, I Am the Winning Candidate" (“민주·진보당, 단일화 안하면 필패… 의원·구청장 지낸 내가 승리 후보”)

Kim Jong-hoon, the Progressive Party candidate for Ulsan mayor, stated in an interview with this publication on the 28th, "Ulsan is a region with strong conservative influence," and "If we fail to create a one-on-one contest with the People Power Party, we are bound for certain defeat," urging the Democratic Party to consolidate candidates. Kim, who started as a labor activist, was elected as an independent lawmaker for Ulsan's Dong District in the 2016 general election and also served a second term as Dong District mayor. (진보당 김종훈 울산시장 후보는 28일 본지 인터뷰에서 “울산은 보수 세가 강한 지역”이라면서 “국민의힘과 1대1 구도를 만들지 않으면 필패할 수밖에 없다”며 더불어민주당에 후보 단일화를 요구했다. 노동운동가 출신인 김 후보는 2016년 총선 때 울산 동구에서 무소속으로 국회의원에 당선됐고, 재선 동구청장도 지냈다.)

-Please evaluate the People Power Party's incumbent Governor Kim Doo-gyeom, who is seeking re-election, and Democratic Party candidate Kim Sang-uk. (-연임에 도전하는 국민의힘 김두겸 현 지사와 민주당 김상욱 후보에 대해 평가해달라.)

"Governor Kim's four years of administration were characterized by uncommunicative governance. There was significant wasteful spending on display-oriented projects. Governor Kim is certainly a righteous person who made courageous choices, such as supporting impeachment after the declaration of martial law. However, his political career spans only two years. Citizens have considerable concerns." (“김 지사의 4년 시정은 불통 행정이었다. 전시성 예산 낭비가 많았다. 김 후보는 계엄 이후 탄핵 찬성 등 용기 있는 선택을 한 정의로운 사람인 것은 분명하다. 하지만 정치 이력이 딱 2년이다. 시민들의 걱정이 상당하다.”)

-You are urging the Democratic Party to consolidate candidates. (-민주당에 후보 단일화를 요구하고 있는데.)

"Merely saying 'Let's change Ulsan' with words alone will not bring about change. Ulsan is a very difficult place for us. This means we must unite our strength." (“말로만 ‘울산을 바꾸자’ 한다고 바꿀 수 있는 것이 아니다. 울산은 우리에게 매우 어려운 곳이다. 힘을 하나로 모아야 한다는 얘기다.”)

-How do you think the consolidation should be carried out? (-어떻게 단일화를 해야 한다고 보나.)

"To secure victory, the consolidation should center on me, as I am gaining momentum. In particular, we must not only unify candidates for mayor but also for district mayors and metropolitan and basic councilors." (“상승세를 타고 있는 나로 단일화가 돼야 승리할 것이다. 특히 시장뿐 아니라 구청장, 광역·기초 의원까지 전부 단일화를 해야 한다.”)

-Candidate Kim Sang-uk is in favor of consolidation, but the Democratic Party leadership seems hesitant about it. (-김상욱 후보는 단일화를 하자는 입장이지만, 민주당 지도부는 아직 단일화에 소극적인 것 같다.)

"Even if consolidation doesn't happen, I will run to the very end. I didn't enter this race just to secure a meaningful vote count. I am here to get elected." (“단일화가 안 돼도 끝까지 뛸 것이다. 의미 있는 득표를 위해 나온 게 아니다. 당선되기 위해 나온 것이다.”)

-There are concerns that if a candidate from a minor party becomes the head of a local government, it will be difficult to secure support from the central government. (-소수 정당 후보가 단체장이 되면 중앙정부 지원을 받아내기 어려울 것이라는 우려가 있다.)

"Such talk is nothing more than election rhetoric. Securing budgets is a battle of ideas. While serving as district mayor, I brought in 104.6 billion won just last year." (“그런 말은 선거용에 불과하다. 예산을 따내는 것은 아이디어 싸움이다. 구청장을 하면서 작년에만 1046억원을 따냈다.”)

-What is the most urgent issue in Ulsan? (-가장 시급한 울산 현안은 뭔가.)

"With Hyundai Motor introducing Atlas (a humanoid robot), anxiety on the ground is high. Through a labor-management-government agreement, I aim to assign difficult labor to AI (artificial intelligence) while allowing people to enjoy happy jobs." (“현대자동차가 아틀라스(인간형 로봇)를 도입한다고 해서 현장의 불안감이 높다. 노사정 협약을 통해 AI(인공지능)에 힘든 노동을 맡기고 사람은 행복한 일자리를 누릴 수 있게 하겠다.”)

-Why should people vote for Kim Jong-hoon? (-왜 김종훈을 뽑아야 하나.)

"This isn't about progressive or conservative labels. Please trust and vote for hardworking Kim Jong-hoon, effective Kim Jong-hoon. If elected mayor, I will create a 'Ulsan-style welfare city' by sharing the profits from companies' adoption of AI and robot technology to generate jobs and fund welfare." (“진보, 보수 개념이 아니라 부지런한 김종훈, 일 잘하는 김종훈을 믿고 써달라. 시장이 되면 기업의 AI·로봇 기술 도입으로 인한 이익을 나눠 일자리 창출과 복지에 쓰는 ‘울산형 복지 도시’를 만들겠다.”)

item.title: USFK Commander: ROK-U.S. Joint Exercises Assume Third-Party Intervention (주한미군사령관 “제3자 개입 가정해 한미 연합 훈련중”)
item.description:
U.S. Forces Korea Commander General Xavier Brunson stated that joint exercises with South Korea are being conducted under scenarios involving "third-party intervention" and "maritime disputes." This suggests a departure from traditional scenarios of a North Korean ground attack, with drills also taking into account threats from China and Russia. (제이비어 브런슨 주한미군사령관이 한국과 함께 ‘제3자 개입’과 ‘해상 분쟁’ 등을 상정한 연합 훈련을 하고 있다고 밝혔다. 북한군이 지상으로 공격해 오는 전통적 시나리오에서 벗어나, 중국과 러시아의 위협도 염두에 둔 훈련도 하고 있다는 취지로 볼 수 있다.)

Last November, General Brunson unveiled an "East-Up Map," describing how "the capabilities of the Korean Peninsula impose a burden preventing the Russian fleet from entering the East Sea, and in the West Sea, they pressure China's Northern Theater Command and the North Sea Fleet." He also characterized U.S. Forces Korea as a force "already deployed within the first island chain," where U.S.-China maritime hegemony confronts each other. (브런슨 사령관은 지난해 11월 ‘동쪽이 위를 향하도록 뒤집힌 지도(East-Up Map)’를 공개하며 “한반도의 역량은 러시아 함대가 동해에 진입하지 못하게 부담을 주고, 서해에선 중국 북부전구군과 북해함대에 부담을 준다”고 말했다. 또 주한미군을 미·중 해상 패권이 대치하는 ‘제1도련선(島鏈線) 내부에 이미 배치된 전력’으로 표현했다.)

In an interview with Japan's "Japan Times" published on the 28th, General Brunson proposed the "Kill Web" concept—a coordinated response where allies, including South Korea, the U.S., Japan, and the Philippines, share real-time information to counter the growing threats from North Korea, China, and Russia. For example, if a U.S. reconnaissance satellite detects provocations from North Korea, China, or Russia, South Korea's ground-based radar would track the target, and Japan would carry out the interception. (28일 공개된 일본 ‘재팬타임스’와의 인터뷰에서 브런슨 사령관은 북·중·러의 증대하는 위협에 맞설 방안으로 한·미·일과 필리핀 등 동맹국이 실시간 정보를 공유하며 조율된 대응을 하는 ‘킬 웹(Kill web)’ 개념을 제시했다. 예를 들어 미국의 정찰 위성이 북·중·러의 도발을 탐지하면, 한국의 지상 레이더가 이를 추적하다가 일본이 요격하는 식의 대응 체제다.)

General Brunson noted that "none of (America's) allies can afford to exist in isolation" and that "connecting them creates overlapping power, making it impossible for an adversary to target any one side." He emphasized that joint response is essential given the military alignment between North Korea and Russia and the increasing military capabilities of China. (브런슨 사령관은 “(미국의) 동맹 중 어느 누구도 고립된 상태로 존재할 여유가 없다”며 “이들(동맹국)을 연결하면 적이 어느 한쪽을 겨냥해 계획을 세울 수 없는 중첩된 힘을 만들 수 있다”고 했다. 북·러가 군사적으로 밀착하고, 중국의 군사력이 증대되는 상황에서 공동 대응이 필수적이라는 것이다.)

Observing the recent trend of starting with cyber attacks and electronic warfare before physically striking an adversary, General Brunson stressed "the side that detects first and acts first has the decisive advantage," highlighting the need for real-time information sharing among allies across land, sea, air, space, and cyber domains. (브런슨 사령관은 적국을 실제 타격하기 전에 사이버 공격과 전자전부터 시작하는 최근의 경향을 볼 때 “먼저 탐지하고 먼저 행동하는 쪽이 결정적 이점을 가진다”면서 육·해·공은 물론 우주·사이버 전반에 걸친 동맹국 간 실시간 정보 공유를 강조했다.)

The Japan Times reported that General Brunson, in outlining this vision, stated that "joint exercises are now designed not around the traditional assumption of a North Korean ground offensive, but rather around third-party intervention, decentralized command and control, and competition and dispute situations at sea." According to this outlet's reporting, scenarios involving maritime disputes have been included in the annual ROK-U.S. joint exercise "Freedom Shield (FS)" and the trilateral ROK-U.S.-Japan exercise "Freedom Edge." (재팬타임스는 브런슨 사령관이 이런 구상을 밝히는 과정에서 “이제는 연합훈련이 전통적으로 가정해 온 북한의 지상 공세가 아니라 제3자 개입, 분산된 지휘·통제, 그리고 해양에서의 경쟁·분쟁 상황을 중심으로 설계되고 있다”고 했다고 전했다. 본지 취재에 따르면 한미 간의 연례 연합훈련인 ‘자유의 방패(FS)’와 한·미·일 3국의 연합훈련인 ‘프리덤 에지’에 해상 분쟁 등의 시나리오가 포함된 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: President Lee Marks Admiral Yi’s Birthday… Shooting a Bow at Asan’s Hyeonchungsa Shrine (충무공 탄신일… 아산 현충사서 활 쏘는 李대통령 )
item.description:
